overture-petg.name: Overture PETG
overture-petg.notes: Earlier stringing fix: 230–235°C with 0.8 mm retraction strung; 220–225°C with ~1.2 mm at 40–45 mm/s fixed it. Temp, retraction and the rest are untested starting points until the tower results are saved. Bed, fan, K and max flow are Prusa PETG defaults.
